# ForgeLLM repository instructions

Read and obey `AGENTS.md`, then the charter and state files named there. Use the nearest nested `AGENTS.md` for path-specific work.

Do not produce speculative performance claims. Every optimization must preserve correctness and include a reproducible baseline, environment manifest, raw samples, and machine-readable benchmark result.

Before proposing a code change, identify the linked issue or task packet, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and tests. Do not broaden scope. Update project state and ADRs whenever the implementation changes them.
